title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Match Production Database Configuration
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29) introduces Match Production Database Configuration, a feature that temporarily aligns a sandbox environment's database settings with production for 72 hours to enable accurate performance testing and support cloud migration processes.
key_points: Temporarily matches sandbox database configuration to production for 72 hours, then automatically reverts after the next update window
Enables more accurate performance testing using the Performance Toolkit by providing the same Azure performance tier as production
Requires environment restart and should be performed when no users are active
Feature is available in Admin Center but may still have some readiness issues

quotes.text: This action temporarily matches your sandbox environment's database configuration to that of a typical production environment database for 72 hours.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core functionality that addresses the performance tier difference between sandbox and production environments

quotes.text: Production environments are deployed on dedicated performance tiers in Azure, ensuring a high level of availability and prioritized support.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies why this feature is needed and the fundamental difference that necessitates matching database configurations for accurate testing

quotes.text: After 72 hours, the environment will automatically be moved back to a sandbox environment database configuration during its next update window.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important operational detail showing the automatic rollback mechanism that prevents permanent sandbox-to-production conversion
